en: Dr. Fe del Mundo invented a bamboo incubator for babies in areas without electricity to keep them warm and safe.
The Ecological Solid Waste Management Act requires every Filipino household to segregate trash to prevent the spread of disease.
The Philippine government bans firecrackers during New Year to prevent severe hand and eye injuries among children.
Indigenous Ifugao farmers use natural pest control in the Banaue Rice Terraces to grow safe, chemical-free rice for healthy communities.
The Sampaguita flower is the national flower and its natural extracts traditionally relieve headaches and fever in Philippine herbal medicine.

topic: Magna Carta of Public Health Workers
en: The Magna Carta of Public Health Workers ensures Filipino nurses receive hazard pay to protect their health while treating patients.
National Scientist Julian Banzon studied coconuts to create safer, local alternatives for food and fuel, reducing exposure to imported chemicals.
The Filipino value of Bayanihan helps communities safely evacuate together during typhoons to protect everyone from flooding and strong winds.
The Land Transportation and Traffic Code mandates that all Filipino motorcycle riders must wear standard protective helmets to prevent fatal head injuries.
National Scientist Alfredo Santos isolated compounds from Philippine plants to create safe, natural botanical pesticides that protect farmers from toxic synthetic chemicals.
The T'boli people weave T'nalak cloth from abaca fibers using natural dyes, avoiding toxic synthetic chemicals that can harm the skin.
The Anti-Bullying Act of 2013 requires all Philippine schools to implement safety protocols that protect students from physical and emotional harm.
